This Privacy Policy explains how FinCalc (“the App”) handles user information. We are committed to protecting your privacy in accordance with the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR) and applicable data protection laws.

FinCalc does not require users to create an account in its basic form; however, in cases where user accounts or optional features are introduced, limited personal information such as name, email address, or authentication credentials may be collected. In addition, the App may collect non-personal usage data such as device information, crash reports, and interaction analytics solely for the purpose of improving performance, stability, and user experience.

Any data stored by the App locally on your device, such as calculation history or user preferences, remains stored on your device unless explicitly stated otherwise. We do not sell, rent, or trade personal data to any third parties under any circumstances.

We may use third-party services such as analytics providers, crash reporting tools, or external financial data sources (for example, currency exchange rate APIs). These third parties may process limited technical data under their own privacy policies, and we are not responsible for their independent practices.

We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to safeguard user data; however, no system of electronic storage or transmission can be guaranteed as completely secure, and we cannot ensure absolute security of information.

Under UK GDPR, users may have rights including access to their data, correction of inaccurate information, deletion of data where applicable, and withdrawal of consent where processing is based on consent. Any requests relating to such rights may be directed to the support contact provided by the developer.

The App is not intended for use by children below the applicable digital consent age, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from minors. If such data is discovered, it will be deleted promptly.

We reserve the right to update or amend this Privacy Policy at any time. Continued use of the App following any updates indicates acceptance of the revised Privacy Policy.

For any privacy-related enquiries, you may contact the developer via the official support email provided within the App.
